caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: transition, above range · 1d: range, above range · 4h: range, above range · 1h: range · 15m: transition, at range bottom. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.

timeframes.invalidation: Une clôture 1w de retour sous 94.84 signifierait que la cassure a échoué et que le prix a réintégré le range.
